title: Looking for Game World Builders
author: NegativePoetry1561
selftext:
Hi, I am currently working on a small MMO, and I need a World Builder, I am gonna just start of with 1 small man about 2km by 2km. It should have a Gibi art style, but I can provide those models.

This game is inspired by a very old MMO from the early 2000s. It needs have cool hunting areas, it will be the training Map for the first 20 Levels.

I will go into more detail once someone applies, I would love to get some previous work from anyone that is willing to help out. Payment is an option.

DM me if you are interested!
